findings.claim_text: $110B is not Anthropic guidance. Reuters attributes it to analysts' estimates and the WSJ to investors' expectations. Anthropic gave no September run rate and no full-year outlook.
findings.contradicting_quote: Anthropic told institutional investors it expects to reach a $110 billion annual revenue run rate by the end of 2026

findings.claim_text: It says Q3 revenue "rose to $16.8 billion from $11.6 billion in the second quarter and $4.7 billion in the first quarter", according to two people who attended an investor day at Anthropic's San Francisco headquarters.
"Adjusted" operating profit excludes stock-based compensation but, on the definition used in Anthropic's May projections, includes training costs.
findings.contradicting_quote: The figure also leaves out stock compensation and the amortization of training compute
